style.prompt: Design a polished warm retro open mic night event poster, vertical composition. Vintage 1970s screen-printed gig-poster aesthetic, warm cream paper texture, burnt orange, mustard gold, deep teal blue, dark brown ink. Central charming illustration of a vintage microphone on a stand with a cable curling beside a small stool, stylized blue doorway framing the stage, subtle radiating golden spotlight, a few understated musical notes and stars. Strong professional graphic design, excellent hierarchy, ample margins, readable typography with large bold rounded retro display lettering and clean supporting type. Include ONLY the following exact text, correctly spelled and laid out attractively: at top very large 'OPEN MIC' then 'NIGHT'; below 'FRIDAY · 7PM'; prominently 'THE BLUE DOOR'; near bottom 'FREE ENTRY'; bottom line 'SIGN UP AT THE DOOR'. No street address. Cozy welcoming intimate live music and poetry atmosphere. The text is integral to the poster and must be crisp, high contrast and clearly legible. Flat printed illustration, tasteful slightly distressed ink, no mockup, no photo of poster, fill the whole canvas with the poster design.
